launches.task:
Language: the user works in English. Write EVERY artifact, question, report and your final message in English.

Feature «Login with 2FA» (id <fid>) in project Alfa.

## User request
I want 2FA

Write the artifact to <home>/features/<fid>/report.md (create the file; markdown in English). The user will read it in the dashboard and approve it or
ask for changes, so write it complete and self-contained.

Doubts you need the user to resolve (do not guess) go in TWO places:
1. In the "## Open questions" section of the artifact, readable by someone who only reads the document:
   - **P1 — Short title:** clear, closed question?
     - [ ] Option A (recommended) — consequence in one sentence
     - [ ] Option B — consequence in one sentence
2. In the file <home>/features/<fid>/questions.json, which the dashboard uses to build the answer form (valid JSON; `[]` if there are no doubts):
   [{"id": "P1", "title": "Short title", "text": "Clear, closed question?",
     "options": [{"label": "Option A — consequence", "recommended": true}, {"label": "Option B — consequence"}]}]
Give 2 to 4 concrete, mutually exclusive options and mark your recommendation with "recommended" (and "(recommended)" in the document).
The user may also write a comment or a question on each item. If you need answers before you can finish, still write the best
provisional version of the artifact, with your assumptions flagged, and the questions in both places.
End with [DONE].

## Phase 1: analysis
You are an ANALYSIS worker. READ-ONLY: do NOT change anything in the repo or outside it, do NOT commit, do NOT install anything, do NOT create
worktrees and do NOT write product code; you only read and run verification commands (ls, git log, grep, the tests
that already exist without modifying them). Do not read or print .env*, keys, tokens or secret files. The only thing you may run
that writes anything is the suggestion command of rule 6 (it creates a dashboard card; it changes nothing in the project).
Answer the user's request above with evidence. Read the project's vault note and the code. There is no spec, plan or worktree.
The artifact is the analysis report, with the sections: Question · Short answer (3 to 5 lines) · Evidence (every claim with its source:
file:line, or the command and its result) · What I could not confirm · Options and next steps (if any; each with cost and risk) ·
Open questions. No claim without evidence: what you did not verify goes under "What I could not confirm".
